verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment. It says Stripe uses OAuth flows where institutions offer them and falls back to Plaid-like aggregator providers for banks without OAuth. That implies OAuth is used for some institutions but credential-based connections remain. No first-party docs describe OAuth coverage, which major institutions are OAuth-only, or any plan to retire legacy credential flows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of OAuth coverage by institution, a documented deprecation or retirement path for credential/screen-scraped connections, and independent hands-on confirmation that major banks connect via bank-hosted OAuth.
